The '''DSK-1 Deathstrike seeker droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] developed by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had a diameter of .4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and was armed with six mounted [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]. The droid's normal mode of transportation was to hover through the air, though its special [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] coils gave the droid the appearance of a rolling sphere. The droid had 360 degree vision and was fond of using tactical fire that completely filled a large area with blaster fire.

When used on the battlefield Deathstrikes were generally loaded into a special launcher that deployed up to six droids near the enemy. Some warlords in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] were known to use these droids to stop riots and kill enemies. Until the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the droids were fairly uncommon, but once the droid was mass produced the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was quick to employ the droid with devastating effects on the battlefield. By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the droid's official use had been suspended, though they were still available on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].
